notes: Animations: 12 entrance, 8 emphasis and 12 exit effects and motion paths, with timing, triggers and text by paragraph, word or letter; an animation pane with a timeline, and a gallery that previews each effect on the slide.
Links on text, shapes, pictures, icons and action buttons, to web pages, e-mail, slides and files (Ctrl+Shift+K).
Video and sound on slides: poster frame, trim, fades, loop, full screen and sound across slides; online video cards.
Header and footer, find and replace, spell check, picture crop, custom gradients, shadows, rulers, gridlines and guides.
Presentations that have a file now save automatically a few seconds after you stop editing (Settings can switch it off).
PowerPoint export and import now carry animations, links, video and sound and the footer. Presentations from 1.0 open with their builds turned into animations.
Fixed: at high display scaling, the first window no longer opens taller than the screen.
